opportunities.title: n8n AI Support Automation
opportunities.description: I need a robust n8n workflow that lets two large-language-model agents—Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini—work together to answer routine customer questions that arrive by email. The flow should: • Ingest new support emails (IMAP or webhook) and pass the text to Claude and Gemini. • Combine or rank their responses, then send the best draft back via email. • If neither model reaches a high-confidence threshold, automatically reply asking the customer for more details rather than escalating to a human. • Log every exchange on my calendar/email platform so I can track turnaround times and see threaded conversations at a glance. Key requirements • All logic must run in n8n; no ad-hoc scripts outside the workflow. • Model routing, confidence scoring, and the clarification loop need to be clearly documented in the n8n nodes so I can tweak thresholds myself later. • Use native n8n credentials management for API keys; do not hard-code secrets. • Provide a short Loom or similar walkthrough plus the exported .json workflow so I can import it directly. Nice to have (not mandatory): hooks for future CRM or chat integrations so I can expand beyond email later. If you’ve already wired Claude or Gemini into n8n, this should be a straightforward build. I’ll test the flow on my sandbox mailbox; once it can handle a sample set of real support queries end-to-end, the project is complete.

Key requirements • All logic must run in n8n; no ad-hoc scripts outside the workflow. • Model routing, confidence scoring, and the clarification loop need to be clearly documented in the n8n nodes so I can tweak thresholds myself later. • Use native n8n credentials management for API keys; do not hard-code secrets. • Provide a short Loom or similar walkthrough plus the exported .json workflow so I can import it directly. Nice to have (not mandatory): hooks for future CRM or chat integrations so I can expand beyond email later. If you’ve already wired Claude or Gemini into n8n, this should be a straightforward build. I’ll test the flow on my sandbox mailbox; once it can handle a sample set of real support queries end-to-end, the project is complete."

opportunities.title: Admin Chat Dukungan Pelanggan

Fokus utamanya adalah menjawab chat dan membantu pelanggan agar setiap pertanyaan teratasi dengan ramah, cepat, dan akurat. Ruang lingkup pekerjaan: • Memantau dan merespons pesan masuk di platform yang sudah ada (WhatsApp, Instagram DM, dan live-chat situs). • Memberi solusi atau panduan singkat sesuai skrip dan SOP yang saya sediakan, lalu meneruskan kasus kompleks ke tim terkait. • Mencatat keluhan, pertanyaan berulang, dan umpan balik pelanggan ke spreadsheet harian. • Menjaga nada komunikasi yang konsisten dengan brand. Saya akan menyediakan akses akun, panduan jawaban, serta jadwal piket. Kamu cukup menyiapkan koneksi internet stabil, laptop/ponsel, dan kemauan belajar cepat tentang produk kami. Deliverable harian: 1. Seluruh chat terbalas maksimal 5 menit setelah masuk (jam kerja yang ditentukan). 2. Rekap singkat end-of-day berisi jumlah chat, isu utama, serta saran perbaikan. Jika kamu terbiasa memakai alat seperti Zendesk, Freshdesk, atau Meta Business Suite, silakan sebutkan pada proposal. Kerja sama dapat diperpanjang bila performa memuaskan.

opportunities.title: SolidWorks Bracket 3D Model
opportunities.description: I need a single-part, fully parametric SolidWorks model of a mechanical bracket that can securely hold a shelf, panel, or frame. This is a standalone 3D part file—no assemblies—so please build the feature tree cleanly with fully defined sketches, sensible naming, and logical order. Standard design practices (fillets where appropriate, draft if needed, and holes sized for common hardware) are expected so the file is ready for manufacture or quick modification later. Please deliver: • Native SolidWorks part file (.SLDPRT) • Neutral export (STEP or IGES) for cross-platform use • Quick visual (PNG or PDF) to confirm geometry without opening CAD Acceptance criteria: the model must rebuild without errors, open in SolidWorks 2020 or later, and show clear mounting points for the intended shelf/panel application.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40822665, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 12,500 - 37,500.

opportunities.title: Lead-Generating Landing Page Build
opportunities.description: I need a conversion-focused landing page that feeds a built-in form directly into my CRM. The single purpose of the page is to get more sales leads, so copy, layout, and loading speed should all encourage a quick submission. The form must be more detailed than a basic opt-in—specifically the “Detailed form” fields we discussed—while giving me the flexibility to add or remove questions later without breaking the integration. Every submission has to flow automatically into my CRM with tags that make future segmentation simple. Whether you choose a native API, Zapier, or a custom webhook, the integration must be seamless and thoroughly tested. Deliverables • Responsive landing page ready to publish on my domain • Custom form with validation, spam protection, and thank-you redirect • Seamless, tested CRM integration with a sample record as proof • Clear instructions so I can edit text, images, and form fields on my own Acceptance criteria The page must load in under three seconds on mobile, render perfectly in the latest versions of Chrome, Safari, and Edge, and capture 100 % of submitted test leads inside the CRM with no duplicates. You may build with WordPress + Elementor, Webflow, or pure HTML/CSS/JS—use whichever is fastest and most maintainable. A working draft within one week would keep the timeline on track, with final delivery after revisions.

opportunities.title: AI Reddit Lead Generation Bot
opportunities.description: I need a cost-effective MVP that runs 24/7 and hunts Reddit for posts where people are actively looking to hire or buy a service. The bot should scan the subreddits and search queries I specify, combine keyword matching with an AI model that scores buying intent, and skip anything that fails to meet the threshold. When a post is tagged as a good lead, I want the system to react on its own—dropping a personalised comment in the thread and sending a tailored DM, provided Reddit’s rules allow it. Duplicate outreach must be prevented so the same user never hears from the bot twice. Key controls—search terms, subreddits, scoring weights, comment/DM templates, and rate limits—need to live in a lightweight dashboard I can tweak without touching code. Telegram notifications are still useful, but purely for visibility rather than manual approval. Please build the entire pipeline (scraper, AI scorer, message generator, scheduler) in a reliable language such as Python, using practical libraries like PRAW, AsyncIO, and an LLM of your choice. Containerised deployment (Docker) or another straightforward way to host the service on a low-cost VPS will help keep operating expenses down. Deliverables: • Source code with clear setup instructions • Simple web dashboard for settings, logs, and lead history • Automated tests or sanity checks that show the duplicate-prevention and AI-scoring logic work as expected • A short video or live demo proving the bot can monitor, score, and auto-reply in real time Acceptance criteria: the bot must identify at least five qualifying posts during a live test, post one unique comment and one DM per lead (no repeats), and show each action instantly in the dashboard and on Telegram. Let me know your proposed tech stack, timeline, and any previous experience building Reddit or social-media automations.

opportunities.description: Company: Pro Accountax Website: https://proaccountax.ca Job Type: Freelance / Commission Only Location: Ontario, Canada Compensation: 20% commission per successfully closed deal Fixed Salary: None About Us We are a full-service finance, accounting and tax consulting firm based in Toronto, Ontario serving our clients all over Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Burlington, Hamilton and Oshawa since 2003. We are engaged in the business of bookkeeping, accounting, compilation & preparation of financial statements, payroll, corporate tax, business tax, personal tax, and business incorporation in Ontario. Having over 20 years of experience in this field we have recently expanded our business and opened new offices in Mississauga, Hamilton and Oshawa thereby created more room for new clients. We are looking for motivated and results-driven Freelance Business Development Partners who can independently identify potential clients, generate leads and close deals for our development services. Your Responsibilities Identify and approach potential businesses that require our finance, accounting & tax filing service. Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, cold calling and other channels. Communicate with business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers. Understand client requirements and present our services professionally or refer to us. Coordinate with our development team for further discussions and quotations. Negotiate with prospective clients within our approved pricing structure. Convert prospects into paying customers and build long-term business relationships. Commission Structure This is a purely commission-based opportunity with no fixed salary or monthly payment. 20% commission on successfully closed projects. Commission is calculated on eligible project revenue actually received from the client. Payments are released after the corresponding client payment is received. Example: If you successfully close a project worth $5,000, your commission could be $1000. There is no limit on your earning potential. The more business you bring in, the more you earn. There are thousands of businesses and corporations that are looking for Accountants, Bookkeepers and Tax Consultants. What We Are Looking For Experience in sales, business development or client acquisition is preferred. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Ability to independently find and approach potential clients. AI features can be used to find potential clients. Confidence in communicating with Canadian and international clients. Self-motivated, professional and target-oriented. We welcome applications from experienced sales professionals, freelance business developers, independent sales agents and individuals with established business networks. What We Offer Attractive 20% commission per successful deal. No restrictions on working hours or location. Access to our development portfolio and service information. Technical and development support from our team. Opportunity to build a long-term business development partnership. Potential to generate recurring business through client relationships. How to Apply When submitting your proposal, please tell us: Your experience in sales or business development. How you would find potential clients for an Accounting and Canadian Tax consultancy firm. Your preferred client acquisition strategies. Important: This is an independent, commission-only freelance opportunity. There is no guaranteed salary, hourly payment or fixed monthly compensation. Earnings depend entirely on successfully acquiring and closing paying clients. We are looking for people who can bring business, close deals & grow together with Pro Accountax.

opportunities.title: Game character: blend a head onto another body’s neck (male + female, Blender → Unity)
opportunities.description: We have a Unity game character made from two asset packs: the head comes from one character system (with face sliders/blendshapes and face bones), the body and clothing from another. We need the head’s lower edge (under the jaw, behind the ears, nape) joined seamlessly to the body’s neck, once for male and once for female. About the attached images: Image 1 – the HEAD we will use. It is open underneath (under the jaw and at the nape); this lower border is what has to be joined to the neck. Image 2 – the BODY we will use (the character in the green T-shirt). We keep this body, its neck and all its clothing. Its own head/face is NOT used; it is replaced by the head from image 1. Image 3 – OUR FAILED ATTEMPT (made with automatic tools). It shows what we do not want: visible seam, stepped edge, crease and colour change between head, neck and chest. This is the problem we are hiring you to fix. Deliverables (per sex): A neck/head-join mesh in Blender (FBX for Unity), welded to the head’s lower border ring and blending into the body’s neck at the collar. Skin weights so it holds up in dance/walk poses (head + neck bones); the top part must follow the head’s face bones/sliders (e.g. jaw width). Matching skin material/UV so there is no visible tone or shading line. Optional: a common neck-skin cut that fits all garments’ collars. Acceptance: no visible seam, gap, colour step or crease from any angle (front, side, back, below) in Unity, in idle and dance poses, across all face presets. We provide: Blender scenes with both characters positioned, reference captures, measurements and our previous attempts. Please share relevant portfolio work (head swaps, character rigging for games).

opportunities.title: House Renovation Construction Drawings and Plans
opportunities.description: My home renovation project will sit on a fully surveyed plot, and I already have the boundary data, topography, and local building regulations on hand. What I need now are complete, construction-ready architectural drawings that translate my concept into precise documents a contractor can build from without guesswork. Scope of work • Scale-accurate floor plans, roof plan, elevations, and at least two building sections • Door, window, and finish schedules aligned with local code requirements • Site plan coordinated with the approved survey, showing setbacks, services, and access • CAD (DWG) files plus printable PDFs sized for A1 sheets Acceptance criteria Drawings must comply with the stated municipal rules, reference the supplied survey coordinates, and be fully dimensioned. I will review one round of mark-ups; final delivery is approved when every comment is closed. Preferred tools are AutoCAD, Revit, or Archicad—use whichever you are fastest with, so long as export to DWG and PDF is clean. All plot data, regulation excerpts, and a rough layout sketch will be shared immediately after award, so you can jump straight into drafting.

opportunities.title: AI Workflow Setup in n8n
opportunities.description: I’m looking to spin up an AI-powered workflow inside n8n. The goal is to connect n8n’s logic nodes with an LLM so the scenario can receive a prompt, process it with the model, and then hand the result back to me or the next system in line. You’re free to propose the most efficient trigger and output channels—website chat, email, Slack, Sheets, or anything else that fits—as long as everything stays within the n8n environment. Here’s what I need from you: • Build and document the complete n8n workflow, including all nodes, credentials, and variables. • Integrate the language-model call (OpenAI, Google Gemini, or similar) with sensible error handling and retry logic. • Provide a short Loom or screenshot walkthrough so I can maintain or extend the scenario later. If you’ve already wired up AI automations in n8n, this should be straightforward. Let me know your approach, the model you’d use, and any prerequisites I should prepare before you dive in.

opportunities.title: Mechanical Design Engineer Wanted – Hydraulic 15-Ton Lifting System for Existing Yacht Transport Trailer
opportunities.description: Hier ist eine gekürzte und prägnante Version auf Englisch, die optimal auf die Plattform passt (deutlich unter 10.000 Zeichen, exakt 7.288 Zeichen inklusive Leerzeichen) und alle Ihre Anforderungen beibehält: Wanted: Mechanical Design Engineer – Hydraulic 15-Ton Lifting System for Existing Yacht Transport Trailer 1. Project Description Looking for an experienced mechanical design engineer to develop a practical, economical, and manufacturing-ready hydraulic lifting system for an existing tandem-axle yacht transport trailer (chassis retained). Language: Written in English to reach international freelancers. Technical info, photos, dimensions, and communication can be in German (German: spoken & written; English: written only). I need an experienced engineer, not just a CAD draftsman. 2. Basic Technical Data Max. payload: 15 tonnes Min. required lifting height: 200 mm Max. height of lifting beams in fully lowered position: 700 mm above ground Trailer: Existing tandem-axle trailer with wheels Materials: S235 steel, or S355 where required Lifting beams: Standard square hollow sections (SHS). Engineer determines tube dimensions, wall thicknesses, and materials. 3. Lifting System Design Two longitudinal lifting beams (left and right), each operated by 2 hydraulic cylinders (4 total). Requirements: Synchronous equal-stroke operation per side; beams must remain parallel to the chassis; left and right beams independently height-adjustable and separately controlled. Reliable sync under uneven loading. Engineer develops the hydraulic solution for synchronization and independent control. 4. Yacht Storage Stands & Support Dimensions Stand widths: 2.00 m (support height 800 mm) or 1.80 m (support height 750 mm). Stand lengths: Standard 3.0 m (min. 2.5 m, max. 4.0 m). Support points: 4 per stand (2 longitudinal, 2 transverse). Shortest stands (2.5 m) hold up to 6 tonnes. Stands are occasionally placed on ~80 mm wooden blocks (to be considered for lift height/geometry). Design must cover all stand variants and support interfaces. 5. Operating Conditions & Safety Private company premises only (no public roads). Yacht transport allowed in raised position (max. transport speed 5 km/h). Safety: Safe load holding, protection against unintended lowering and hose/line failure. Dynamic transport loads (acceleration, braking, cornering, uneven ground) must be considered. Engineer evaluates necessary safety measures and checks if mechanical locks are required. 6. Hydraulic Power Unit & Electrical Supply 12 V battery-powered HPU mounted on trailer. Engineer specifies: Motor, pump, tank, operating pressure, flow rate, valves, hoses/pipes, electrical power/peak current, battery voltage/capacity, recommended battery type, and charging system. Includes hydraulic circuit diagram and BOM. Target: ~60 complete lifting cycles (raise + lower) per charge. Operation: Interface for radio or wired remote control (allow for both). Note: I will mount the HPU on the trailer. 7. Engineering Scope & Calculations Assessment and measurement of existing trailer/space. Structural calculation of the longitudinal beams of the main chassis only for additional lifting loads. Design of longitudinal lifting beams (SHS). Design of cylinder mounts, guides, bearings, pivots, and connections. Selection and sizing of 4 hydraulic cylinders. Development of synchronization and independent control. HPU selection, circuit diagram, and BOM. Force, geometry, movement, and lifting calculations. Preliminary strength/stability checks for new structure and chassis longitudinal beams. Consideration of uneven/eccentric loads, torsion, and transport dynamics. Welded joint design and battery sizing (~60 cycles). Complete manufacturing-ready design. 8. Calculation Approach – Practical & Cost-Effective Practical approach preferred. Extensive FEM reports not required unless technically necessary. Covers chassis longitudinal beams, lifting beams, cylinder forces/stroke, pressure/flow, synchronization, HPU/battery, and main load cases. Assumptions and results must be clearly documented. 9. CAD & Manufacturing Deliverables Readable on a standard PC without expensive software (PDFs, images): Complete 3D CAD model integrated with trailer chassis + editable native CAD + STEP files. Manufacturing drawings (PDF), 3D views, assembly drawings, welding details, BOM. 1:1 DXF files for flame/plasma cutting (clean, closed contours, no duplicates). Hydraulic circuit diagram, component list, 12 V electrical/battery specs. 10. Existing Information Photos with handwritten dimensions and reference images provided. Unclear dimensions must be agreed upon beforehand. 11. Required Experience Hydraulic lifting systems, cylinder synchronisation, heavy-duty/welded structures, vehicle/trailer construction, structural calculations, manufacturing-oriented CAD, 12 V HPUs, and workshop drawings. Heavy transport experience is a plus. 12. Proposal Requirements & Milestones Include: Intro/background, comparable projects, CAD software used, sync/control approach, recommended HPU/battery, estimated duration, and detailed quotation. Milestone 1: Technical concept & initial 3D design. Milestone 2: Completed mechanical design, chassis longitudinal beam & strength calculations, hydraulic design, HPU/battery sizing. Milestone 3: Manufacturing drawings, DXF files, BOM, and full documentation handover. 13. Important Note Safety-relevant 15-tonne design. Economical, practical, and manufacturing-ready approach required while fulfilling essential safety standards. Must be reviewed by a qualified professional before commissioning.

Engineer determines tube dimensions, wall thicknesses, and materials. 3. Lifting System Design Two longitudinal lifting beams (left and right), each operated by 2 hydraulic cylinders (4 total). Requirements: Synchronous equal-stroke operation per side; beams must remain parallel to the chassis; left and right beams independently height-adjustable and separately controlled. Reliable sync under uneven loading. Engineer develops the hydraulic solution for synchronization and independent control. 4. Yacht Storage Stands & Support Dimensions Stand widths: 2.00 m (support height 800 mm) or 1.80 m (support height 750 mm). Stand lengths: Standard 3.0 m (min. 2.5 m, max. 4.0 m). Support points: 4 per stand (2 longitudinal, 2 transverse). Shortest stands (2.5 m) hold up to 6 tonnes. Stands are occasionally placed on ~80 mm wooden blocks (to be considered for lift height/geometry). Design must cover all stand variants and support interfaces. 5. Operating Conditions & Safety Private company premises only (no public roads). Yacht transport allowed in raised position (max. transport speed 5 km/h). Safety: Safe load holding, protection against unintended lowering and hose/line failure. Dynamic transport loads (acceleration, braking, cornering, uneven ground) must be considered. Engineer evaluates necessary safety measures and checks if mechanical locks are required. 6. Hydraulic Power Unit & Electrical Supply 12 V battery-powered HPU mounted on trailer. Engineer specifies: Motor, pump, tank, operating pressure, flow rate, valves, hoses/pipes, electrical power/peak current, battery voltage/capacity, recommended battery type, and charging system. Includes hydraulic circuit diagram and BOM. Target: ~60 complete lifting cycles (raise + lower) per charge. Operation: Interface for radio or wired remote control (allow for both). Note: I will mount the HPU on the trailer. 7. Engineering Scope & Calculations Assessment and measurement of existing trailer/space. Structural calculation of the longitudinal beams of the main chassis only for additional lifting loads. Design of longitudinal lifting beams (SHS). Design of cylinder mounts, guides, bearings, pivots, and connections. Selection and sizing of 4 hydraulic cylinders. Development of synchronization and independent control. HPU selection, circuit diagram, and BOM. Force, geometry, movement, and lifting calculations. Preliminary strength/stability checks for new structure and chassis longitudinal beams. Consideration of uneven/eccentric loads, torsion, and transport dynamics. Welded joint design and battery sizing (~60 cycles). Complete manufacturing-ready design. 8. Calculation Approach – Practical & Cost-Effective Practical approach preferred. Extensive FEM reports not required unless technically necessary. Covers chassis longitudinal beams, lifting beams, cylinder forces/stroke, pressure/flow, synchronization, HPU/battery, and main load cases. Assumptions and results must be clearly documented. 9. CAD & Manufacturing Deliverables Readable on a standard PC without expensive software (PDFs, images): Complete 3D CAD model integrated with trailer chassis + editable native CAD + STEP files. Manufacturing drawings (PDF), 3D views, assembly drawings, welding details, BOM. 1:1 DXF files for flame/plasma cutting (clean, closed contours, no duplicates). Hydraulic circuit diagram, component list, 12 V electrical/battery specs. 10. Existing Information Photos with handwritten dimensions and reference images provided. Unclear dimensions must be agreed upon beforehand. 11. Required Experience Hydraulic lifting systems, cylinder synchronisation, heavy-duty/welded structures, vehicle/trailer construction, structural calculations, manufacturing-oriented CAD, 12 V HPUs, and workshop drawings. Heavy transport experience is a plus. 12. Proposal Requirements & Milestones Include: Intro/background, comparable projects, CAD software used, sync/control approach, recommended HPU/battery, estimated duration, and detailed quotation. Milestone 1: Technical concept & initial 3D design. Milestone 2: Completed mechanical design, chassis longitudinal beam & strength calculations, hydraulic design, HPU/battery sizing. Milestone 3: Manufacturing drawings, DXF files, BOM, and full documentation handover. 13. Important Note Safety-relevant 15-tonne design. Economical, practical, and manufacturing-ready approach required while fulfilling essential safety standards. Must be reviewed by a qualified professional before commissioning."

opportunities.title: Mechanical Part 3D CAD Modeling
opportunities.description: I will supply hand-sketched views, clear dimensional data, and any necessary tolerances for a small machine part / tool that must be machined. Your task is to translate those measurements into an accurate, fully-parametric 3D model suitable for CNC programming, CAM verification, and general manufacturing documentation. A STEP file is the minimum final deliverable; if you can also generate native files from SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion 360, or similar mid-range CAD platforms, that’s a plus. Once the solid is complete, I’ll need a simple, dimensioned drawing to double-check critical sizes before release to the shop. Please tell me about previous machining-oriented modeling projects you have completed—especially anything involving tight tolerances, complex geometries, or jigs and fixtures—so I know you can handle the practical side of production.

opportunities.title: Public Buildings Renovation Survey in various places in UP, Per Day Basis
opportunities.description: I am commissioning a state-wide survey of existing schools, hospitals, and other public buildings throughout Uttar Pradesh. For each site I will need you to take accurate measurements, prepare clear as-built drawings, and compile a concise set of renovation notes that address three specific areas: • structural soundness and any required strengthening, • interior repairs and layout improvements, • building services upgrades covering electrical, plumbing, and fire-safety systems. Your report should not only highlight every deficiency but also propose practical, architecturally appealing solutions that bring the facility up to current standards. AutoCAD or Revit proficiency is essential for the drawings, and familiarity with NBC 2016 and relevant local bye-laws will help you flag compliance gaps quickly. Because this assignment involves multiple sites, the ability to travel within the state and turn around each building package on a tight schedule is important. When you respond, focus on your experience carrying out similar measured surveys and renovation assessments for institutional or public structures; sample pages or redacted drawing sets are especially helpful. Typical deliverables per building: PDF and editable CAD files of the documented plans, sections, and elevations; a photo-referenced condition report; and a bullet-point action list ranked by urgency and approximate effort. I will review each submission against the on-site evidence, so clarity and accuracy are key to approval and payment.

opportunities.title: Photorealistic 3D Rendering for Residential & Commercial Spaces - 17/11/2026 06:17 EST
opportunities.description: I have several projects that need immediate, photorealistic 3D visualization for both residential and commercial spaces. On the residential side, you’ll handle full-house exteriors plus key interiors such as kitchens and bedrooms; commercially, I need exteriors and interior spaces like lobbies or open-plan offices rendered with the same level of detail. My clients expect high-impact images they can drop straight into presentations and marketing decks, so clean lighting, accurate materials, and realistic staging are essential. I generally supply CAD or SketchUp models, reference photos, and a mood board—you transform them into polished stills. Tools such as 3ds Max or Blender with V-Ray, Corona, or similar render engines are perfectly fine, as long as you can turn work around quickly without sacrificing quality. Deliverables • 4–6 hero renders per space in 2K+ resolution • Native scene files, logically organized for future edits • One revision pass after first draft • Final assets delivered via a shared cloud folder Acceptance criteria • Consistent color balance, no visible noise at 100 % zoom • Materials and proportions that match references exactly • Lighting that sells depth while remaining true to real-world fixtures The first batch is due ASAP, so let me know your typical turnaround per scene and share links to two standout renders that prove you can hit this standard.

opportunities.title: Full-Home Modern Classic Interior
opportunities.description: I’m looking to have my entire home—every single room from the entryway through the bedrooms and bathrooms—designed in a cohesive classic style. In the public areas I want a timeless, elegant vibe, while the more private spaces should lean toward a modern classic look with simple, refined detailing rather than heavy ornamentation. Your main deliverable is a complete set of high-quality 3D images that clearly illustrate how each room will look once finished. Renderings should be realistic enough for me to understand colour balance, materials, lighting temperature and furniture proportions before anything is purchased. I’m comfortable with whichever professional tool you normally use—3ds Max + V-Ray, SketchUp + Enscape, or an equivalent—but please make sure you can supply both the final renders and the editable source files. Acceptance criteria • One photorealistic perspective per major wall and an overhead shot for every room. • Consistent palette and detailing from space to space; bedrooms and bathrooms must follow the modern classic brief. • Two rounds of coordinated revisions based on my feedback. • Final archive delivered in organised folders (high-res JPEG/PNG + native project files). If this aligns with your skills and workflow, let’s discuss timeline and any information you need from my end (measurements, inspiration images, existing floor plans, etc.) so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Produce 3D Children’s Comedy Episode
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced 3D animator or professional animation studio to produce a complete 11–12-minute episode of an original children's comedy series. The episode will include engaging characters, dialogues, funny interactions, expressive animations, and creative storytelling. An NDA will be required before sharing any project materials. We will provide the complete script, character designs, storyboards, scene breakdowns, camera directions, visual references, and initial animation samples. We need a production partner who can turn these materials into a professionally finished animated episode. The work will include 3D character modelling and rigging, environment creation, character animation, English voiceovers, lip-sync, background music, sound effects, lighting, rendering, editing, and final post-production. We are open to traditional 3D animation or AI-assisted workflows, provided the final output maintains consistent characters, environments, and professional animation quality. We are not interested in simply combining separate AI-generated clips. The final delivery should include one complete 11–12-minute episode in 1080p minimum (4K preferred), individual scenes, character models, rigs, relevant production assets, editable project files, and agreed commercial rights and ownership. Revisions will be discussed at different production stages. We would like to start with a short paid animation test, followed by approval of the characters and workflow, full episode production, final editing, and delivery. Please include the following in your proposal: Portfolio links showing completed 3D character animations. Children's animation samples, if available. Software and production workflow you use. Fixed price for the complete episode. Estimated delivery timeline. Details of whether voiceovers, music, sound effects, and editing are included. Confirmation that editable source files can be provided. Confirmation that you are willing to sign an NDA and complete a short paid animation test. Please cover all the above points in your proposal, as incomplete applications may not be considered

opportunities.title: Lifelike AI Dog Speech Video -- 2
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a three-minute wedding speech and the star is my dog—he’s literally the best man. I’ll supply a set of high-resolution photos plus the full script; what I need from you is an AI-generated, near-photoreal video where he stands at a mic, moves naturally, and lip-syncs every word. Key points to hit • Visual realism: please treat this as a 3-D, film-quality render—realistic fur, muscle movement, accurate shadows, and subtle facial expressions that match canine anatomy while still forming human-style mouth shapes for the dialogue. • Human voice-over: the finished clip must sync perfectly with a clean human voice track (we can use a professional VO you source - UK accent). • Continuous take: the scene should play straight for roughly three minutes without jarring cuts, with gentle camera moves or close-ups for emphasis. • Delivery format: 1920×1080 (or higher if practical), H.264/MP4, plus any project files so we can revisit later. This video will be shown on a large projector screen so needs to stand up to that. Please outline the AI pipeline or tools you plan to use—Runway, Stable Diffusion, Unreal, Blender, or a custom combination—so I know the look and flexibility we’ll have for tweaks. Three minor revision rounds for timing, expression or lighting adjustments should be built in. Once approved, I’ll hand you the photos and the script and we can get started right away. Looking forward to seeing my best man come to life on screen!

opportunities.title: Diseño de 3 Artes para Campaña de Instagram (Stories + Post)
opportunities.description: Hola. Soy un emprendimiento pequeño de educación online que ofrece cursos de inglés para profesionales hispanohablantes. Estoy preparando mi primera campaña pagada en Instagram y busco un diseñador o diseñadora que me ayude con los artes fijos. Qué necesito: 3 artes que formen parte de una misma campaña. Cada uno aborda un mensaje distinto, pero los tres tienen que sentirse de la misma familia: verse juntos y que se note que son de la misma marca y campaña. Cada arte en dos formatos: Story: 1080 x 1920 px (9:16) Post: 1080 x 1350 px (4:5) Total: 6 piezas. Cómo vamos a trabajar: Yo te compartiré los textos de cada arte. Definiremos juntos la estética de la campaña antes de diseñar las 3 piezas. La marca ya tiene logo, colores y tipografías, y te los compartiré. opportunities.title: Recuperación y Protección de Datos Web
opportunities.description: He sufrido una filtración de datos en mi sitio; información sensible quedó expuesta y necesitamos actuar con rapidez. Busco a alguien que investigue el punto exacto de la brecha, restaure la integridad de la base de datos y refuerce la seguridad del sistema para evitar nuevos incidentes. Trabajamos con un stack PHP / MySQL sobre servidor Linux, pero estoy abierto a las herramientas que consideres más efectivas (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, WAF, hardening de Apache, etc.). Lo importante es que documentes cada paso y entregues un reporte claro de qué ocurrió, cómo se solucionó y qué controles quedaron activos. Entrego acceso SSH, panel de control y copia de respaldo reciente. Necesito confidencialidad absoluta y disponibilidad para coordinar pruebas en horario GMT-5. Entregables clave: • Informe forense del incidente (hallazgos, vector de ataque, alcance). • Restauración o reparación de los datos comprometidos. • Aplicación de parches y configuración endurecida del servidor. • Plan de monitoreo y recomendaciones post-incidente. Aceptar el trabajo implica dejar el sitio estable, sin alertas de integridad y con los registros de auditoría activados. Si puedes comenzar de inmediato, avísame tu estimación de horas y próxima ventana para la primera revisión.

opportunities.title: Aliado estratégico para generación de ventas
opportunities.organization: Cliente J. C. S. F. (🇨🇴 Colombia)
opportunities.description: Distyle, una marca colombiana especializada en joggers deportivos, busca un aliado estratégico comercial para atraer clientes, gestionar el proceso de venta y entregar compradores con pedidos confirmados. El objetivo es impulsar el crecimiento de la marca a través de una estrategia de ventas efectiva y sostenible. Funciones principales: - Diseñar e implementar estrategias innovadoras para la atracción de compradores. - Prospectar y captar clientes potenciales de manera proactiva. - Asesorar a los interesados y convertirlos en compradores efectivos. - Gestionar el cierre de cada venta, asegurando la confirmación del pedido. - Entregar a Distyle los datos completos de los clientes y los pedidos confirmados. Compensación: Se ofrece una comisión de $7.000 COP por cada venta entregada y efectiva, validada y recibida exitosamente por el cliente. Condiciones de la alianza: - El postulante deberá presentar una estrategia propia y detallada de adquisición de clientes. - Deberá especificar quién asumirá la inversión publicitaria y cuánto presupuesto estima necesario para las campañas. - Se iniciará con una prueba de 15 días para evaluar el desempeño y la compatibilidad. - Se realizará una reunión semanal para revisar los resultados y ajustar la estrategia si es necesario. - La evaluación se basará en las ventas entregadas, el costo de adquisición de clientes, el porcentaje de devoluciones y la rentabilidad generada. Perfil buscado: Buscamos una persona o equipo con sólida experiencia en marketing digital, prospección de clientes, ventas a través de WhatsApp y redes sociales, y habilidades probadas en cierre comercial. Valoramos la iniciativa, la orientación a resultados y el interés en establecer una relación comercial de largo plazo. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Comercial / Vendedor Tamaño del proyecto: Grande

opportunities.title: E-commerce El Paraíso de Ana
opportunities.description: Deseo lanzar la tienda en línea de mi marca, “El paraíso de Ana”, dedicada a productos de belleza y cuidado personal. Busco que el sitio permita a cada cliente comprar y pagar en línea de forma rápida y segura. Lo que necesito: • Diseño y desarrollo completo del e-commerce (puede ser en Shopify, WooCommerce o la plataforma que mejor se adapte). • Configuración de la pasarela de pago con tarjetas y, si es viable, wallets digitales populares. • Estructura de catálogo lista para que yo cargue productos, con categorías, filtros básicos y ficha de artículo clara (foto, descripción, precio, stock). • Plantilla responsive que se vea impecable en móvil y escritorio. • Área de administración sencilla donde pueda revisar y cambiar inventario, aplicar cupones y descargar reportes de ventas. • Integración de correo transaccional para confirmar compras y facilitar el seguimiento de pedidos. Valoraría que prepares un tutorial breve o guía paso a paso (video o PDF) para que mi equipo pueda añadir nuevos productos sin depender siempre de soporte técnico. Por ahora la prioridad es la compra con pago integrado; funciones extra como la creación de cuentas o la opción de recogida podrán añadirse en una fase posterior, así que déjalas preparadas para activarlas cuando llegue el momento. Entrego el logotipo y la paleta de colores; necesito que todo respete esa identidad visual. Si tienes ejemplos de tiendas similares que hayas construido, compártelos: me ayudará a decidir con rapidez.

opportunities.title: Especialista UniFi Configuración Remota
opportunities.description: Descripción: Buscamos un Técnico de Redes con experiencia comprobable o certificación en la plataforma Ubiquiti UniFi para sumarse a nuestro equipo bajo modalidad Medio Tiempo (4 horas diarias), 100% remoto desde cualquier país de Latinoamérica (Colombia, Perú, Venezuela, Bolivia, Argentina, etc.). Es una posición ideal para profesionales independientes, consultores IT o administradores de red que deseen sumar un ingreso fijo mensual en dólares con horarios predecibles. Responsabilidades: Administración, monitoreo y aprovisionamiento remoto de consolas y equipos UniFi (Gateways, Switches, Access Points). Configuración y optimización de VLANs, reglas de Firewall, perfiles de radiofrecuencia (RF), roaming, portales cautivos y VPNs. Atención de tickets de soporte programados y ajustes de configuración solicitados por clientes. Verificación de actualizaciones de firmware, respaldos de controladoras y documentación básica de cambios. Requisitos: Experiencia mínima de 2 años gestionando controladoras UniFi Network (Cloud Keys, UDM Pro/SE, servidores Cloud/Self-Hosted). Certificación Ubiquiti (UWA, URSCA o UFSP) altamente valorada, o experiencia práctica equivalente demostrable. Dominio de direccionamiento IP, subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, DNS y diagnóstico de redes Wi-Fi. Disponibilidad de 4 horas diarias (Lunes a Viernes) en horario a convenir [Mencionar tu zona horaria, ej: GMT-4 / GMT-5]. Internet estable y computadora propia. Qué ofrecemos: Pago mensual fijo: $400 USD netos (vía Binance/USDT, Payoneer, Global66 o transferencia según tu país). 100% Remoto: Trabaja desde casa con total flexibilidad para compatibilizar con otros proyectos personales. Relación a largo plazo: Posibilidad de ampliar horas y honorarios según el crecimiento de la cartera de clientes. ¿Cómo postular? Envía tu CV y detalle de tu experiencia con UniFi (incluye certificados si los tienes) a [Tu Correo / WhatsApp / Link] indicando tu país y disponibilidad horaria.

opportunities.title: Edición Limpia de Reels - 16/11/2026 16:14 EST
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando una serie de contenidos cortos para Instagram, TikTok y YouTube Shorts. Dispongo del metraje bruto en formato vertical (1080 × 1920) y un breve outline por pieza. Quiero transformar cada clip en un video limpio y profesional, con edición sencilla: cortes precisos, ritmo fluido y sin efectos agresivos. Elementos imprescindibles • Música de fondo suave, libre de derechos, perfectamente sincronizada. • Exportación final en .mp4 H.264 1080 × 1920. • Archivo editable de CapCut (o equivalente) para ajustes posteriores. Opcional, pero bienvenido • Subtítulos cuando el audio no sea claro. • Miniatura estática con texto destacado siguiendo la estética del video. Alcance inicial: 10 videos de 30-60 s. Si el resultado encaja, el flujo será recurrente. Para coherencia visual facilitaré paleta, tipografía y logotipo. También escucho sugerencias sobre hooks, duración ideal y buenas prácticas de retención. Entregables por video 1. Video final listo para publicar. 2. Proyecto editable. 3. opportunities.title: Diseñador/arquitecto para casa en San Luis Talpa, El Salvador -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco un diseñador o arquitecto para acompañar las decisiones de diseño de Casa Zalamar, una casa en construcción en San Luis Talpa, La Paz, El Salvador. Ya tenemos un modelo 3D preciso, selecciones por ambiente y un paquete eléctrico de referencia. Pueden ver una vista previa del proyecto en https://public.smp-properties.com. El trabajo es de diseño y distribución (layout) solamente: proponer, revisar y recomendar. El dimensionamiento, el cumplimiento normativo y la firma o liberación de las instalaciones corresponden al electricista o ingeniero del propietario. Todo el trabajo se realiza en un espacio de trabajo compartido (zalamar.smp-properties.com), con herramientas de IA. Los entregables se envían como cambios (commits / pull requests) al repositorio Git del proyecto. Yo me encargo de la puesta en marcha y de la capacitación, sin costo; no hace falta experiencia previa en Git. Me gustaría empezar por horas o con un primer alcance pequeño y fijo: un plano de iluminación, apagadores y circuitos (qué luces van con qué apagador), porque la losa aún no se ha colado. Si el trabajo fluye bien, hay más alcances de diseño. Habrá visitas ocasionales a obra en San Luis Talpa. Adjunto un PDF con la solicitud de propuesta completa (menú de alcances, forma de trabajo y condiciones). En su propuesta, por favor incluyan: - Su tarifa por hora en USD (y, si gustan, un precio fijo para el plano de iluminación, apagadores y circuitos). - Portafolio: 2 o 3 proyectos relevantes con planos o imágenes, idealmente al menos uno de iluminación o apagadores. - Una o dos referencias de clientes anteriores que podamos contactar por la plataforma. - Dónde están ubicados, el tiempo de viaje hasta San Luis Talpa y su disponibilidad para comenzar. Saludos, Steve --- English: I'm looking for a designer or architect for Casa Zalamar, a house under construction in San Luis Talpa, La Paz, El Salvador. You can preview the project at https://public.smp-properties.com. The work is design and layout only: no engineering sizing, code compliance, or sign-off. We'll work in my shared AI workspace and Git repository; I'll handle setup and training at no cost, and you don't need prior Git experience. I'd like to start hourly or with a small fixed first task: a lighting, switch and circuit plan (which lights go with which switch). There will be occasional site visits in San Luis Talpa. Please see the attached RFP PDF. In your proposal, include your hourly rate in USD (and optionally a fixed price for the lighting, switch and circuit plan), 2 or 3 relevant portfolio projects with plans or images (ideally one lighting or switch layout), one or two past-client references we can contact through the platform, and your location, travel time to San Luis Talpa, and availability. Thanks, Steve

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Software Estadístico con Inteligencia Artificial y Visión por Computadora
opportunities.description: Se requiere un profesional experimentado para el desarrollo de un software estadístico innovador. Este sistema deberá utilizar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial, específicamente identificación facial y visión por computadora, para el monitoreo y análisis de datos relacionados con personas y con pleno cumplimiento a la legislación vigente. El software tendrá la capacidad de integrar diversas fuentes de información, realizar análisis en tiempo real y presentar los resultados de manera efectiva a través de una interfaz de usuario intuitiva, con visualizaciones y reportes de fácil entendimiento. Se valorará la experiencia en procesamiento de datos y en el desarrollo de este tipo de tecnologías avanzadas. Los entregables esperados incluyen el código fuente completo del sistema, documentación técnica detallada, un manual de usuario exhaustivo, así como soporte para el seguimiento, puesta en marcha y los ajustes necesarios del sistema. El prototipo deberá incorporar un sistema de localización GPS. Es fundamental que el software demuestre una elevada tasa de exactitud y sea capaz de operar de manera eficiente en condiciones de luminosidad reducida. Además, toda la información recopilada por el sistema deberá ser enviada a una central remota para su procesamiento y almacenamiento. Los profesionales interesados, deberán mostrar flexibilidad para acordar las condiciones de trabajo y la compensación económica del proyecto, la que será en función del avance del proyecto, considerando eventualmente otras formas de incentivo. También se solicita presentar un presupuesto realista, el que no debe ser modificado sustancialmente posteriormente por el desarrollador. Asimismo el profesional seleccionado deberá previamente al inicio del trabajo, firmar un contrato legalizado por escrito de confidencialidad y cesión de derechos de obra por encargo. Se considerará de manera especial a profesionales chilenos, aunque la selección no sera excluyente y dependerá de las condiciones y propuestas presentadas.

opportunities.title: Diseñador de Vestuario para Producciones Audiovisuales con Intelige...
opportunities.description: En Diseños del Arte llc (dda group) estamos desarrollando producciones audiovisuales innovadoras mediante inteligencia artificial y buscamos un profesional de diseño de vestuario altamente creativo y detallista para colaborar en la creación visual de nuestros personajes. Este rol es fundamental para construir personajes e historias auténticas desde cada detalle. Su participación se centrará en la definición completa del vestuario, calzado y accesorios para cada personaje. Será crucial considerar la época, el contexto cultural, la personalidad individual, la ocupación y las situaciones específicas de la historia para asegurar la coherencia y profundidad visual. Las responsabilidades clave incluyen: - Elaborar propuestas de vestuario detalladas por personaje, acompañadas de referencias visuales claras y concisas. - Realizar la selección de colores, telas, texturas, siluetas y accesorios que mejor se adapten a cada concepto. - Planificar los cambios de vestuario y establecer criterios de continuidad rigurosos, siguiendo el guion de las producciones. - Proporcionar indicaciones precisas y claras al artista visual encargado de generar las imágenes finales utilizando herramientas de inteligencia artificial. - Revisar meticulosamente las imágenes generadas para asegurar que el vestuario corresponda fielmente con la propuesta aprobada. Buscamos un profesional con sensibilidad narrativa, una atención excepcional al detalle y una probada capacidad para investigar y comunicar visualmente sus propuestas. Se valorará la experiencia previa en cine, televisión, teatro, publicidad o en proyectos de vestuario de época. Aunque la experiencia con herramientas de IA es un plus, no es un requisito indispensable. La colaboración se establece bajo la modalidad de servicios profesionales por proyecto y por entregables, con un alcance, honorarios, fechas y revisiones que serán acordados previamente. Estamos abiertos a considerar colaboradores que trabajen a distancia. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Diseño de moda ¿Qué necesitas?: Más de 10 prendas

opportunities.title: SDR Telefónico B2B para Pymes Españolas
opportunities.description: El Proyecto: Somos BuzzBlend SL, consultora tecnológica en España. Buscamos un SDR / Appointment Setter telefónico para contactar con decisores de pymes españolas y agendar reuniones de cualificación. Te damos toda la infraestructura: Leads en bandeja: Base de datos B2B ya extraída y cualificada. Herramientas listas: Trabajas desde nuestra plataforma interna con CRM, correo y llamadas VoIP integradas. Soporte: Guiones y gestión de objeciones. Remuneración (100% a Éxito - Comisiones hasta 1.000€): Pagamos por cliente cerrado (cita agendada por ti que termina en venta). Usamos un sistema de rápel retroactivo, los pagos se liberan por hitos: Base: 450€ por cada venta cerrada. Desde la 6ª venta: 550€ por venta (y se regularizan las 5 anteriores a 550€ también). Desde la 11ª venta: 650€ por venta (y anteriores). Desde la 16ª venta: 750€ por venta (y anteriores). Tope: Hasta 1.000€ de comisión por cliente. Requisitos: Experiencia demostrable en Cold Calling B2B a pymes españolas. Español nativo o neutro perfecto. FILTRO ANTI-SPAM: Para descartar bots, debes empezar tu propuesta respondiendo a esto: "Llamas a una pyme y recepción te dice: 'El jefe está ocupado, mándanos un email y ya lo mira'. ¿Cómo debates esto para conseguir la cita?" (Descartaré las propuestas que no respondan a esto).

opportunities.title: Diseños Urgentes para Redes Sociales
opportunities.description: Necesito, con carácter de urgencia, que me prepares publicaciones e historias diseñadas específicamente para Instagram, Facebook y TikTok. Quiero piezas visuales coherentes entre sí, que respeten la identidad de mi marca (te paso colores y tipografías en cuanto arranquemos) y que ya vengan en los tamaños y resoluciones recomendados para cada plataforma. El objetivo es que el contenido luzca moderno, invite a la interacción y pueda publicarse de inmediato. Yo puedo facilitar textos y referencias, aunque valoro cualquier propuesta creativa que mejore el mensaje. Plazos: requiero ver las primeras propuestas en 24-48 h y recibir los archivos finales editables (PSD, AI o Canva) junto con sus versiones optimizadas en PNG/MP4. Si hay algo más que necesites saber para avanzar rápido, dime y lo resolvemos al momento.

opportunities.title: Chatbot WhatsApp Pedidos y Reservas
opportunities.description: Necesito habilitar respuestas automáticas en mi cuenta de WhatsApp Business para gestionar pedidos y reservas de forma fluida. El flujo ideal es simple: el bot saluda, solicita nombre y datos de contacto y confirma el pedido o la reserva. Toda esa información debe enviarse y guardarse directamente en el sistema de gestión que ya uso (dispongo de API/webhooks y credenciales).
